{{EventEnd|Aprilini Foolsini Eventini|date = 8th of April 2026}} {{AprilFoolsInfobox |image1 = TripleT.png |dates = 1 April 2026 – 8 April 2026 |reruns_included = [[April Fools 2024 Event]] |previous_edition = [[April Fools 2025 Event|Baseplate 2025]] |next_edition = TBA |previous_event = [[The Final Act Event]] |next_event = [[Spring Frenzy Battle Pass|Spring Frenzy]] }} ==Description== The '''Aprilini Foolsini Eventini''', was the seventh April Fools edition and the twenty-sixth event to be added in Tower Defense Simulator. It was the third April Fools edition to be considered an event. This event added the [[Brain Rot (2026)|Brain Rot]] modifier to every match, alongside a rerun of [[Headache Headquarters]]. It started with [[Headache Headquarters]] on the 1st of April 2026, few hours later followed by the [[Brain Rot (2026)|Brain Rot]] modifier. Since 2nd of April 2026, the [[Brain Rot (2026)|Brain Rot]] has now been disabled. [[Headache Headquarters]] remained active until the 8th of April 2026. ==Maps== {| class="empty-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" |[[File:HeadacheHeadquartersIcon.png|link=Headache_Headquarters|175px]] |- |[[Headache Headquarters]] |} ==Skins== Skin obtained by triumphing [[Headache Headquarters]].
